Gift ideas to explore

A milestone keepsake

Cessna 172 Skyhawk model

$249.00

The best model is often the aircraft with a story behind it. This mahogany Skyhawk is especially thoughtful for someone who learned to fly a Cessna 172.

Buying tips

Confirm their aircraft type. A 172 and a 182 are different airplanes, even if they look similar.

View at Pilot Mall ↗
Off-duty aviation

Cessna patch trucker cap

$34.99

A casual option for the Cessna enthusiast who already owns the flight gear they need. The navy-and-scarlet color scheme makes it easy to wear away from the airport.

Buying tips

Confirm they like caps and Cessna; a familiar logo is more personal than a random airplane.

View at Pilot Mall ↗
Wear their favorite airplane

Cessna 182 Skylane tee

$29.99

A good match for someone with a connection to the Skylane. Aircraft-specific clothing works best when the reference is meaningful to the person receiving it.

Buying tips

Choose the right size and check the seller’s return policy before ordering.
